title: The states of a registered target
claim: A new target starts in the initial state, and a deregistered target drains before it becomes unused.
alt: A state diagram with five states: initial, healthy, unhealthy, draining and unused. Passing a health check leads from initial to healthy; failed checks lead from healthy to unhealthy and passed checks lead back; deregistration leads from healthy to draining, and the end of the delay leads to unused.
